verdicts.reason: A: the CTA has shrunk to a tiny pill, far smaller than in the original, and the LIMITED badge sits about 100px to its right, so the two no longer read as a group. Neither element lines up with the centred headline, and a large empty band separates the headline from the action. B keeps the badge next to the CTA, but both are tiny and pushed into the bottom-left corner with only about 25px of margin. That left edge clashes with the centred headline, and the middle of the canvas is a big dead area. B wins narrowly because its grouping and headline placement are better.
